intro: Bright and modern, our Diner dining table in hush white brings elegant simplicity and everyday functionality to your dining space with a clean, calming presence.

features.title: Sleek hush white top
features.text: Lacquered MDF top in a fresh hush white finish gives your dining room a modern touch that’s easy to match and effortless to maintain.

features.title: Built to last
features.text: The strong rubberwood frame offers long-term durability, making this table ideal for everyday meals and weekend get-togethers alike.

features.title: Minimalist, modern look
features.text: Its clean lines and balanced design bring timeless simplicity to any interior—from minimal chic to cozy contemporary.

features.title: Legs for more room
features.text: Angular legs placed at the edges create extra legroom and open up the table space—more comfort for everyone at the table.

features.title: Safe, soft edges
features.text: Rounded corners provide a gentle, safe edge while elevating the table’s overall sophistication with a soft, refined silhouette.

name: Diner 6-Seater Rectangular Solidwood Dining Table
